source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fresh full five-file C++/IDL/Rust read-status patch read. Copying from a folder obtains the current header's isRead; creation from a MIME file uses !mIsDraft for the initial Sent/Draft case. The Boolean travels through createMessage and the Rust request sets Message.is_read explicitly. A newly created draft being unread does not forbid the user marking an existing draft read later. The Bug corrects the initial broad MIME-derived-flags claim: whether the original message has been replied/forwarded is distinct from this message being a reply/forward. Extended-property possibilities remain disputed/uncertain, not proved impossible or implemented by this patch. The small {} initializer removal is author uncertainty, not a C++ initialization recommendation. Fixed message creation is factored into ExchangePerformMessageCreateFromCopy (reads the source flag) and the file-source branch, then forwarded to EWS create_message.rs. That fixed request still sets is_read, while also containing separate explicit TODOs about unconditional MSGFLAG_READ in PR_MESSAGE_FLAGS and draft handling. This study does not claim complete consistency of every remote flag. Reviewer reports the read fix works; no message copy, live EWS request, remote state or automated test ran.
title: Copy the source read state separately from MIME content and draft creation defaults
